name: arbitrage-stress-tests
description: Artillery stress tests for Arbitrage Dashboard API and WebSocket endpoints

scripts.test:all: npm run test:api && npm run test:ws
scripts.test:ws:report: artillery run --output reports/ws-report.json websocket-load.yml && artillery report reports/ws-report.json --output reports/ws-report.html
scripts.test:api:report: artillery run --output reports/api-report.json api-load.yml && artillery report reports/api-report.json --output reports/api-report.html
